metadata.title: Cloud Infrastructure-as-a-Service Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for securely operating consumer-managed infrastructure resources in public or private cloud environments under a shared responsibility model.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud infrastructure services including virtual machines, networks, storage, and provider control planes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Defines foundational trust assumptions for consumer-managed cloud IaaS resources.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Cloud infrastructure trust depends on hosting model and jurisdictional assumptions.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Cloud IaaS security relies on trusted automation and management control planes.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Infrastructure-as-a-Service Core defines the baseline trust properties required to safely operate consumer-managed cloud infrastructure. This pattern makes shared responsibility boundaries explicit and establishes trust assumptions for identity, isolation, control planes, and resource ownership, without prescribing provider-specific services or configurations.

components.title: IaaS Resource Isolation
components.description: Separation of cloud tenants, subscriptions, projects, or accounts to prevent cross-boundary access.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement across improperly isolated cloud resources.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation of cloud infrastructure resources through logical segmentation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection between cloud infrastructure domains.
Information flow control between cloud resource boundaries.

components.title: Cloud Control Plane Awareness
components.description: Understanding and constraining trust in provider-managed control planes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid identities to access cloud management APIs.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governance and restriction of privileged cloud control-plane access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Strong authentication for cloud management access.
Least privilege for cloud control-plane roles.

components.title: Consumer Responsibility Enforcement
components.description: Explicit ownership and enforcement of cloud security controls assigned to the consumer.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Account or role manipulation through mismanaged consumer-owned permissions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit definition and enforcement of consumer-owned security responsibilities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security planning reflects shared responsibility boundaries.
Risk assessments account for consumer-managed cloud responsibilities.
